source.title: cmd/geth: fix logging line count error
source.body: Report the expected and actual console log line counts in the correct order. The test already compares the lengths correctly, but the failure message printed have before want.

added: t.Errorf("format %v, want %d lines, have %d", format, len(wantLines), len(haveLines))
deleted: t.Errorf("format %v, want %d lines, have %d", format, len(haveLines), len(wantLines))

source.title: core/vm: fix random stack error message
source.body: Report the expected and actual stack lengths in the correct order when TestRandom fails. The assertion already checks have/want correctly, but the failure message printed them swapped.

added: t.Errorf("test '%v': want %d item(s) on stack, have %d: ", tt.name, want, have)
deleted: t.Errorf("test '%v': want %d item(s) on stack, have %d: ", tt.name, have, want)

source.title: beacon/engine: only print the bad hash on error
source.body: Better error messages on the engine api
